principle: Treat UESP as a provenance-bearing container. Preserve the UESP passage and, when available, normalize its cited underlying Elder Scrolls evidence separately.

reference_kinds.notes: Preserve game/expansion, speaker, quest/context when available.
Event evidence is distinct from dialogue and from wiki interpretation.
Primary artifact but narrator may be mistaken, biased, legendary, or fictional in-universe.
Record author/persona and whether text is in-universe or editorial.
Do not silently equate with shipped-game evidence.

examples: Unofficial developer posts when UESP labels them unofficial

reference_kinds.notes: Useful for discovery; lower evidentiary weight than traceable underlying sources.

quality_signals.notes: UESP cleanup categories can explicitly identify lore pages needing game-specific material removed or other cleanup.
Preserve UESP's explicit warning that references are unofficial.
Do not collapse legend, belief, theory, or conflicting account into objective fact.
Store accounts independently; do not force a resolution.

page_classes.handling: chunk prose and references; map inline citations to normalized references when possible
store book metadata and text as an in-universe primary artifact; distinguish author claims from world facts
link to lore-book work when available; preserve game-specific ID/location metadata separately
use as direct game evidence where appropriate; do not mix gameplay mechanics into lore claims without typing them
